media.alt_text:
Under President Biden’s Inflation Reduction Act:
1. If you are one of the millions of Medicare beneficiaries who takes high-cost drugs, then your high-cost drugs could be subject to Medicare negotiation and you could see your costs go down
2. If you are one of 50 million Americans with Medicare drug coverage, then your standard coverage will cap your annual prescription drug costs at $2,000
3. If you are one of 3.3 million Medicare beneficiaries with diabetes who takes insulin, then you won’t pay more than $35 for a month’s supply of insulin
